tasks.goal: Patrol the Charter Hall perimeter, stopping at each charter display plinth so visitors can read the contribution model.
tasks.terrain: Flat polished hall floor with low plinth obstacles and visitor queue stanchions; wetland-adjacent humidity may slick entry matting.
success: Localization covariance < 0.1 m^2 at each stop
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward confirms the tour route does not obstruct charter reading areas.

tasks.goal: Carry a proposal summary tablet from the moderator desk to each debate table when a new draft is posted.
tasks.terrain: Carpeted forum floor; chair legs, raised floor cable raceways, and seated participants' feet as low obstacles.
success: Tablet delivered to 4/4 tables within 10 min
Speech announcement played at each stop
tasks.human_in_loop: A moderator approves the draft before delivery and can cancel any leg.

tasks.goal: Retrieve labeled evidence binders from shelf bays and place them on the synthesis desk for the Research Synthesis Agent workflow.
tasks.terrain: Lab flooring with cable trays, shelf lip edges at 0.9-1.4 m, and rolling carts that shift positions between runs.
success: Binder placed within 2 cm of desk target
tasks.human_in_loop: A researcher verifies binder identity before each shelf pick and final placement.

tasks.goal: Sort task-routing cards into working-group trays on the Operations Deck kiosk table using arm manipulation.
tasks.terrain: Fixed kiosk table; tray dividers, uneven card stacks, and occasional laptop edges within the arm workspace.
success: 8 cards sorted to correct trays in <4 min
safety_stops: Workspace boundary virtual wall at table edge
Operator hand detected in camera frame pause
tasks.human_in_loop: A coordinator approves the card-to-tray mapping before each session.

tasks.goal: Hover-inspect the progress dashboard wall LEDs and log which outcome metrics are lit for the Progress Tracker.
tasks.terrain: Open atrium volume with hanging signage cables and a glass railing at 3 m; indoor airflow from HVAC vents near ceiling.
success: Hold 0.1 m position hold error at 6 stations
safety_stops: Distance to any surface <0.3 m retreat
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves flight volume and confirms logged metric states are recorded.

tasks.goal: Patrol the exterior boardwalk viewing deck over the restored bayfront marsh and report surface conditions back to the Observatory.
tasks.terrain: Wooden boardwalk over restored tidal marsh: wet planks, algae-slick edges, tidal water below, gap seams every 2 m; bay wind gusts on the open deck.
success: Complete 60 m boardwalk loop without slip-fall
Detect and log wet/slippery plank segments >=80% recall vs. manual labels
tasks.human_in_loop: A safety officer approves each outdoor patrol given tide and wind conditions.

tasks.goal: Escort visitor groups between the Charter Hall entrance and the Proposal Forum along an accessible indoor route.
tasks.terrain: Smooth concrete and matting floors, glass doors, tight 1.2 m corridors near exhibit panels, and wet shoe zones at the marsh-side entrance.
success: Escort 4 groups with <2 min mean wait-to-follow error
safety_stops: Person within 1 m slow, 0.5 m stop
tasks.human_in_loop: A docent approves the route each day and can halt the escort at any time.

tasks.goal: Set up charter exhibit panels: lift panel boards from a cart and align them onto wall mounts at the hall entrance.
tasks.terrain: Hall floor with cart casters, 2 kg panel boards with edge chamfers, wall mounts at 1.6 m requiring balance under load.
success: ZMP inside support polygon 100% of cycles
tasks.human_in_loop: An exhibit steward approves panel placement and mounting torque before final release.
